# Taskflow

> A dual-language restaurant: two independent kitchens (TS/Fastify, Python/FastAPI)
> cook the same API contract behind one door (Auth0) and an external cashier
> (Razorpay), sharing only Postgres and the public contract — never each other's code.
> Docs carry WHY / DECIDED / NEXT-OWED-TO / DEBT; the code is the WHAT.
>
> **Read order:** `README.md` (below) → `../docs/prompts/master.md` (the 18 rules)
> → the latest note + its ADR + the roadmap's Next row → then *code*.

## NOW
*(derived on every run — never hand-edited)*
- last: day-16 (2026-10-22 — razorpay-webhooks) → notes/day-16-razorpay-webhooks-2026-10-22-1435.md
- git: dev
- open debts: 14a · 16a → debt.md (triggers, not dates)
- next: Live Razorpay round-trip (16a) — a real rzp_test_ order + a real webhook event against a running env; the wiring is done and tested with fakes, the live delivery rides along when a real charge is wanted. … → roadmap §16 (../docs/roadmaps/v4/master.md)

## Docs map (everything in this tree)
- [README](README.md): what lives where + the EOD procedure
- [daily-flow](daily-flow.md): your daily operating sheet — the full cycle (kickoff → work → closeout) in one file
- [debt](debt.md): *the* debt ledger — one row per debt; grep this to see what's open
- [product/taskflow/taskflow-product](product/taskflow/taskflow-product.md): the TaskFlow **spec** — what it is, who it's for, why it feels good (stable; no "next")
- [product/taskflow/taskflow-build](product/taskflow/taskflow-build.md): the TaskFlow **build ledger** — how we build + prove it's right (*this* drives the roadmap)
- [product/taskflow/design-pattern-ledger](product/taskflow/design-pattern-ledger.md): the TaskFlow **design-pattern ledger** — what pattern is in use, why, and the swap story each one buys (stable; grows as the roadmap lands patterns)
- [roadmap](../docs/roadmaps/v4/master.md): the single living roadmap — one line per day; *grep for NEXT*
- [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md): the session-start pointer (rules 1/4) — a new agent session reads this first

## v1-era history — docs/ (read-only; touch it only when a past decision is needed)
- [ADRs](../docs/adrs/): the pre-v2 decision log — read *one on demand*, never in bulk
- [day notes](../docs/notes/) · [day prompts](../docs/prompts/)
- [master prompt (the 18 rules)](../docs/prompts/master.md): read on *any* session
- [scraps](../docs/scraps/README.md): the user's private backup — *do not* read or cite unprompted

## Code — where the *what* lives (docs carry WHY/DECIDED/DEBT; the code is the source of the rest)
- [py kitchen](../apps/taskflow/py/src/): FastAPI — main.py composition root, auth.py, db.py, repository.py
- [ts kitchen](../apps/taskflow/ts/src/): Fastify/ESM — server.ts composition root, auth.ts, db.ts
- [golden matrix](../apps/taskflow/py/tests): the *parity-by-test* source of truth — read before touching either kitchen's auth
- [smoke tests](../apps/taskflow/scripts/smoke.sh): the live-door tests (ADR-009) — *MISSING (deleted 2026-10-05 on purpose — docs-generation test artifact; regenerate, don't restore)*
- [deploy](../apps/taskflow/deploy/): env template + prod compose (ADR-006)
- [CI](../.github/workflows/ci.yml): the zero-service golden-matrix gate (ADR-010)
